original_title: The Boys Actor Antony Starr Says Goodbye to Homelander With Spoiler-Heavy Behind-the-Scenes Photos
summary_en: Now that The Boys is finally over, actor Antony Starr has taken to Instagram to bid farewell to his time as Homelander with a very spoiler-y photo gallery. Warning! Spoilers for The Boys series finale follow. "Ok I feel like spoilers aren’t really a thing now but…spoilers," Starr said in t
